description:
StateTree at runtime: list and inspect compiled StateTree assets, run them on any actor (a StateTreeComponent is added
when needed), send events and read the active states. Epic's StateTree toolset only inspects editor data; this one
reads the cooked runtime data (state names, tasks, conditions, transitions and events survive cooking; editor-only
details such as descriptions, colors, comments and property bindings do not).

Workflow:
1. statetree.list_state_trees, then statetree.describe_state_tree to learn the states and the events it listens for.
2. statetree.run_state_tree on an actor (trees using StateTreeComponentSchema).
3. statetree.send_event with the transition event tags; statetree.get_active_states to see where it is.
4. statetree.stop_state_tree / statetree.restart_state_tree; undo of run_state_tree removes the added component.
StateTree assets cannot be authored at runtime (compilation is editor-only): build them in the editor.
name: statetree

tools.description:
Describes a compiled StateTree from its runtime data: schema, global evaluators and tasks, and every state with its tasks, enter conditions and transitions (trigger, event tag, target), plus the event tags it listens for.
Returns: The structure. Fails if the asset is not a StateTree.

asset.description: StateTree asset path, e.g. "/Game/AI/ST_Guard.ST_Guard". (Reference to StateTree: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: statetree.describe_state_tree

returnValue.description: The structure. Fails if the asset is not a StateTree.

name.description: Node name given in the editor (may be empty).

events.description: Event tags any transition or state listens for, sorted.

name.description: Node name given in the editor (may be empty).

ready_to_run.description: True if the asset is compiled and linked (it can run).

schema.description: Schema class, e.g. "StateTreeComponentSchema" (statetree.run_state_tree needs this one or a child).

states.description: States in tree order (parents before children).

name.description: Node name given in the editor (may be empty).

linked_asset.description: Linked StateTree asset path for LinkedAsset states.

path.description: Path from the root, e.g. "Root/Combat/Attack" (names joined by /).

required_event.description: Event tag required to enter the state (may be empty).

selection.description: How children are selected, e.g. TrySelectChildrenInOrder.

name.description: Node name given in the editor (may be empty).
Node name given in the editor (may be empty).

delay.description: Delay in seconds before it fires (0 = immediate).

enabled.description: False if disabled in the asset.

event_tag.description: Event tag that triggers it (OnEvent), empty otherwise. Send it with statetree.send_event.

payload_type.description: Payload struct the event must carry (empty = none).

priority.description: Low, Normal, Medium, High or Critical.

target.description: Target state path, or Succeeded / Failed / Stopped (tree completion), or "" for none.

trigger.description: When it is tried: OnStateCompleted, OnStateSucceeded, OnStateFailed, OnTick, OnEvent or OnDelegate.

type.description: State, Group, Linked, LinkedAsset or Subtree.

returnValue.title: RuntimeStateTreeDescription

tools.description:
Returns the StateTree execution state on an actor: run status and active states.
Returns: Status, active state names (root to leaf) and paths. Fails if the actor has no StateTreeComponent.

target.description: Actor with a StateTreeComponent, e.g. "n12". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: statetree.get_active_states

returnValue.description: Status, active state names (root to leaf) and paths. Fails if the actor has no StateTreeComponent.

active_paths.description: Active state paths per frame, e.g. ["Root/Patrol/MoveTo"].

active_states.description: Active state names, root first, leaf last (linked trees add their states).

added_component.description: True if a StateTree component was added by this call (run_state_tree only).

status.description: Running, Stopped, Succeeded, Failed or Unset.

tree.description: StateTree asset path running on the actor.

returnValue.title: RuntimeStateTreeStatus

path.description: Object path, e.g. "/Game/AI/ST_Guard.ST_Guard" (pass to describe_state_tree or run_state_tree).

tools.description:
Runs a StateTree on an actor: adds a StateTreeComponent if the actor has none, sets the tree and starts the logic. Undoable (stops it and removes the added component, or restores the previous tree).
Returns: Execution state after starting (status, active states). Fails if the tree is not compiled, uses another schema, or does not start (missing context data).

asset.description: StateTree asset path, e.g. "/Game/AI/ST_Guard.ST_Guard". Its schema must be StateTreeComponentSchema (or a child). (Reference to StateTree: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

target.description: The actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: statetree.run_state_tree

returnValue.description: Execution state after starting (status, active states). Fails if the tree is not compiled, uses another schema, or does not start (missing context data).

added_component.description: True if a StateTree component was added by this call (run_state_tree only).

status.description: Running, Stopped, Succeeded, Failed or Unset.

tree.description: StateTree asset path running on the actor.

returnValue.title: RuntimeStateTreeStatus

tools.description:
Sends an event to the StateTree running on an actor. Transitions listening for the tag fire on the next tree update.
Returns: Execution state after sending. Fails if the tag is unknown (close matches), the tree is not running, or the payload does not fit.

payload.description: Optional payload fields as JSON, converted to the payload struct the tree's transitions expect for this tag, e.g. {"location": [100, 0, 0]}. (Any JSON value)

tag.description: Event gameplay tag, e.g. "AI.Event.Alert" (statetree.describe_state_tree lists the events a tree uses).

target.description: Actor running a StateTree, e.g. "n12". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: statetree.send_event

returnValue.description: Execution state after sending. Fails if the tag is unknown (close matches), the tree is not running, or the payload does not fit.

active_states.description: Active state names, root first, leaf last (linked trees add their states).

status.description: Running, Stopped, Succeeded, Failed or Unset.

tree.description: StateTree asset path running on the actor.
